feed.title: Google Cloud: Audit Manager
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: Audit Manager

entry.content: Support for organization-level audits, audit scheduling, and a new UI experience with updated reports are generally available (GA).
entry.summary: Organization-level audits, audit scheduling, and an updated UI with new reports are now generally available. This release enhances your ability to manage and view audit information.
entry.title: Feature: New Audit Features Now Available

entry.content: Audit Manager includes Gemini-generated summaries that provide high-level information about the audit results for cloud controls, controls, or resources in Preview.
entry.summary: Audit Manager now offers Gemini-generated summaries for audit results. These summaries provide a high-level overview of compliance scores for cloud controls, controls, and resources, currently in Preview.
entry.title: Feature: New Gemini Summaries in Audit Manager

entry.content: You can download FedRAMP 20x Class B (Low) compliance documents from Audit Manager.
entry.summary: You can now download FedRAMP 20x Class B (Low) compliance documents directly from Audit Manager. This feature allows for easier access to essential compliance information.
entry.title: Feature: Compliance Documents Available

entry.content: The remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Audit Manager is generally available (GA).
entry.summary: The remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Audit Manager has reached general availability. This feature allows for enhanced management of audit processes.
entry.title: Feature: Remote Model Context Protocol Server is now available

entry.content:
Audit Manager includes the following features in Preview:

  • A new UI and report experience
  • Ability to schedule audits
  • Ability to run audits at an organization level
entry.summary: Audit Manager is introducing new features in preview, including an updated UI and reporting experience, the ability to schedule audits, and the option to run audits at the organization level. These enhancements aim to streamline compliance management and reporting processes.
entry.title: Feature: Audit Manager Enhancements Now in Preview

entry.content: Audit Manager now supports built-in frameworks and custom frameworks that you define using Compliance Manager or Assured Workloads frameworks (preview).
entry.summary: Audit Manager now supports built-in and custom frameworks. You can define your own compliance frameworks using Compliance Manager or Assured Workloads frameworks (preview) to enhance your auditing process.
entry.title: Feature: Audit Manager: New Framework Support

entry.content: Audit Manager lets you download Google Cloud compliance documents. You can use these documents to better understand how Google addresses its responsibilities to meet the requirements of various regulatory frameworks.
entry.summary: Users can now download compliance documents from Audit Manager to understand Google Cloud
entry.title: Feature: Compliance Documents Available
